findings.plain: A fresh synthesis agent needs 60-80k tokens just to learn the current research state, because no index of findings or directions exists.
findings.setup: Token estimate from file sizes across .scratch, memory, reports and docs.

findings.plain: The unreadable glued-together state files come from the model re-reading its own compressed prose and compounding it; the same glue leaked into the memory index.
findings.setup: Measured share of 20+ character tokens per paragraph in the affected file and in Codex rollout logs.

findings.plain: Only 13 of 2,683 analysis result files record the code commit they came from.

incidents.effect: Wrong claim reached the user and a memory note
incidents.fix: Memory note corrected; model defaults kept only as a safety net
incidents.what: A research agent reported that Codex workers had been running on Astra; the user's own check showed 215 of 253 ran Sol. The agent inferred from config files without checking the spawn logs.

incidents.fix: Feature directory moved into the worktree (matches the approved layout); Alignment-side files are staged and applied by the orchestrator
incidents.what: The worktree isolation hook refuses writes to the Alignment checkout and compound shell commands, so the feature directory could not be created where first planned.

incidents.effect: About 2.5 hours of wall-clock delay on ticket 04; no wrong output
incidents.fix: Orchestrator resumed it once, then wrote the final comparison section itself from the agent's logs. Lesson for the protocol: an agent must not end its turn while a background run it owns is unfinished; it should wait on the run or hand the comparison to the orchestrator explicitly.
incidents.what: The ticket 04 agent went idle twice without finishing: once at 1:20 pm with its drafts only in scratch and nothing in the worktree, and again at 4:06 pm after launching the final test runs, which it never came back to read.

incidents.effect: None: the command changed nothing, but agents may not run git at all.
incidents.fix: The agent brief forbids every git subcommand for agents, and the orchestrator alone runs git.
incidents.what: The planning agent ran one read-only git command while drafting the plan.

needs.text: Four decisions, in order, from docs/research/autoresearch-workflow/merge-checklist.md: (a) approve merging the autoresearch-workflow branch into Deception-Circuit main, and the commit of the applied Alignment-side files; (b) after the merge, the archive moves of the four closed scratch directories (wave B, reversible, verified by script); (c) your go for the Codex config change (wave C: default worker model Sol, shinka and weco off), which needs a Codex restart; (d) confirmation that the live Codex session is finished, so its directories and the two memory logs can be archived (wave D).

Waiting on you for four decisions, in the merge checklist: merge the branch, then the archive moves (wave B); the Codex config change (wave C, needs a Codex restart); and the live Codex session's files (wave D, after you confirm that session is finished).
